# Industry-Based Feature List
<!-- id: features.industry-based-feature-list -->

Version: 2026-08-09

Purpose: Recommended website, application, portal, marketplace, commerce, booking, operational, or SaaS capabilities by industry using the canonical semantic profile matrix.

> This is a product-planning reference, not a requirement that every business implement every feature. Selection must follow the actual creation type, business model, user journeys, jurisdiction, security/privacy obligations, operational capacity, and project goal.

# How to Use This List
<!-- id: features.how-to-use-this-list -->

- Resolve the industry through `INDUSTRIES.md`, then resolve Operating/Product/Design/Halo/Risk dimensions through `PROFILE_MATRIX.md`.
- If the canonical industry is in the Mixed-Model Registry, resolve the exact subindustry/business model before treating defaults as implementation requirements.
- Apply canonical base risk overlays, then add project/subindustry-triggered overlays using `profile-matrix.dynamic-risk-resolution`.
- Treat each industry section as a capability shortlist, not an instruction to build every capability.
- Creation type wins over generic capability breadth: a marketing site does not silently become a portal; a full SaaS request does not silently collapse into a brochure.
- Product Profile contributes the interaction model; Operating Profile contributes real operational workflows; Design Profile contributes domain-specific capability overlays.
- Remove features that do not fit the business model and add project-specific requirements explicitly.
- Convert selected capabilities into requirements, permissions, analytics events, error states, security controls, and acceptance criteria before implementation.

# Cross-Industry Baseline
<!-- id: features.cross-industry-baseline -->

- Responsive, mobile-first experience
- Clear service/product navigation
- Search where content or inventory volume warrants it
- Contact, inquiry, lead-capture, or support workflow appropriate to the model
- Analytics, conversion/event tracking, and operational reporting
- SEO-ready metadata and structured content for public surfaces
- Accessibility-conscious interface and keyboard-operable critical workflows
- Privacy, consent, legal-policy, and security controls appropriate to collected data
